newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CENTRAL BANK SAYS Q1 FDI HITS $303.7 MLN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CENTRAL BANK SAYS Q1 FDI HITS $303.7 MLN.

text.p: Total foreign direct investment into the Czech Republic for the first quarter of 1997 was $303.7 million, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Thursday.

"Direct foreign investment into the Czech Republic amounted to, in crown terms, about the same as the first quarter of last year (when adjusting for exchange rate developements)" a CNB statement said.
The statement said that total FDI from January 1, 1990 to the end of March was $6.9 billion.

It said that of first quarter investment, the banking sector received a 42.1 percent share, followed by the trade and service sectors (25 percent), and the foodstuffs industrial sector (20.9 percent).
It added that Germany led all nations in the first quarter with 47.4 percent of first quarter FDI, with the U.S. second at 21.1 percent and the Netherlands with 16.7 percent.
